column1: # Who runs what. The one place that says it.
# FLEET REWRITE (2026-08-07, ch-dev): this manifest now describes the Group_GY DSW
# fleet -- seven 8xH100 boxes with ONE shared filesystem (/mgfs, verified by
# write-here-read-there) -- not the original m1-m3+cornell layout. The original
# cluster's completed runs (vanilla_s0, c1_lsm, on A100s) are NOT carried over:
# different silicon is already a registered deviation (PROTOCOL-unified §2.5), and
# every verdict wants arms and noise floor measured in ONE batch. Everything runs
# fresh here, under one fingerprint family.
# Columns:  wave  machine  arm  seed  [note]
#   wave     runs in ascending order; a machine finishes its wave-N list before N+1
#   machine  m1=dsw251  m2=dsw252  m3=dsw253  m4=dsw254   (8xH100 each, 4 lanes)
#            registered in .campaign/MACHINE_MAP via `MACHINE=<name> bash deploy/up.sh`.
#            dsw258/261/262 are deliberately held back: free for evals,
#            informativeness, D6 probes -- anything ad-hoc -- without competing with
#            campaign lanes. Enlist one by registering it (m5...) and adding rows.
#   arm      a run_id from configs/arms.yaml
#   seed     data.seed and rollout.seed
# deploy/campaign.sh --plan audits this against the registry: every runnable arm must
# appear exactly once, and it reports any that do not.
# ROLLOUT_GPU_MEM_UTIL is pinned to 0.45 for the WHOLE campaign by campaign.sh, not
# per row. One value = one batch = one noise floor shared by every arm.
# a1_gkd_mix0.5 is deliberately absent -- registry status 'needs'. Interleaving
# teacher-generated responses lands inside the TransferQueue agent loop, which is
# trainer surgery, and a2_coldstart already gives axis A an off-policy arm.
# ---- wave 1: the whole Phase-1 screen at once ---------------------------------
# 16 runs over 16 lanes, four boxes. m1 carries all three vanilla seeds -- THE noise
# floor, every verdict's denominator -- so the reference and its spread come from one
# box and any machine effect rides on the arms, not on the floor.
